businessModelStatement: AirconToCool is a matching service run by the OurKampung team. We pass your enquiry to a partner aircon firm, which quotes and does the work.

formSubmit.note: The build uses PUBLIC_FORM_ENDPOINT (a repo variable in CI, set to the family's FormSubmit alias on 5 Oct 2026) and falls back to this raw address when it is unset. The alias is activated for aircontocool.com.
